description: This file defines a minimal Spring Security configuration class ensuring compatibility with Spring Boot 3 and Spring Security 6. It configures HTTP security to permit unauthenticated access to Swagger UI, static resources, and enforces authentication on other requests.

classes.name: SecurityCompatibilityConfig
classes.description: A configuration class annotated with @Configuration and @EnableWebSecurity that defines security settings for the application.

methods.name: defaultSecurityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines and builds the SecurityFilterChain bean, configuring HTTP security to permit access to Swagger UI and static resources while requiring authentication for other requests.
